theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_etp_edge_direction_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (a e : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → 0 < δ → 1 ≤ k → (∀ t φ : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 < φ → φ < δ → HasMassDensity C (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) k) → ∃ l₀ : ℝ, 0 < l₀ ∧ ∀ l : ℝ, 0 < l → l < l₀ → a + l • e ∈ C.support
